mwer_loss: expected word-error count under softmax(.9 attention log probability + .1 CTC log probability) + .1 conventional loss
ce_loss: .9 author label-smoothed attention loss + .1 CTC loss
dropout: disabled in both arms; gradients enabled
candidate_refresh: generated using epoch-start weights; fixed within epoch; no reference injected
selection: At least .005 absolute macro WER gain, pooled CER no worse, each dataset WER at most .002 worse. Select lowest macro WER before audit/test.
note: Pilot only; existing validation/test previously examined. Not independent of original pretraining. No new tuning on audit/test.
